summary: Angled kerb bays along parkland on Hunter Street; nearest homes over 25 m away.
reasons: Bays back onto botanic gardens parkland
Homes 26 m+ away across the cross street

best_section.where: Southern end of the angled bays, just north of the cross street

drivers.seclusion: Bays back onto trees and park lawn. Nearest dwellings are 26 m south, across the side street; industrial and bus depot buildings sit opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Angled bays off a wide road, fully out of the through lanes. Roughly 20 bays marked.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road next to the bays; noise from buses and cars.
drivers.convention: Bays are full of parked cars along the whole stretch, so a van will blend in.

flags: Steep: about 6% here, 7% average along the bays
Council No Stopping and Bus Zone signs on nearby streets; check the bays themselves on site
Busy road noise and bus depot opposite
sun_shade: Tree canopy to the west shades afternoon sun; open to the east.
